text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The day of the Champions Cup.
At the venue 
are Wonder Acute, whom she faced before, 
and Espoir City,
the one to keep an eye on this time.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
A premier race where dirt champions from 
across the nation gather. Yet Transcend 
felt no anxiety; she was thrilled,
getting the exact excitement she had been 
searching for.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Imagining the feeling of competing
against 
powerful rivals and coming out on top,
she 
geared herself up with determination.
